description: Boundary-failure matrix (M0-E01-S01 draft). Defines responsibilities only; no recovery is implemented in this story. Runtime fault injection and reconciliation are verified by M0-E02-S07.

api-restart.retry_responsibility: Browser retries idempotent reads; state-changing requests are retried only with the same idempotency key.
api-restart.idempotency: Operations are keyed by (project_id, idempotency_key); a replay returns the existing operation.

operation-manager-restart.retry_responsibility: On restart the operation manager reloads persisted operations; non-terminal operations are re-observed before any further action, never blindly re-executed.
operation-manager-restart.idempotency: Operations resume by operation id and recorded attempt number; a replayed submission with the same (project_id, idempotency_key) returns the existing operation.

agent-timeout.retry_responsibility: Operation manager marks the attempt outcome unknown and must observe host state before any retry; never blind-retries destructive commands.
agent-timeout.idempotency: Each typed host command carries operation id and attempt number recorded by the operation manager (single store writer); commands are idempotent per (operation id, attempt) and the agent keeps no durable state.

agent-unavailable.retry_responsibility: Operation stays pending with bounded backoff and a finite attempt limit, then retryable_failure.
agent-unavailable.idempotency: No command was delivered; resubmission uses the same operation id.

host-agent-crash.retry_responsibility: The operation manager treats in-flight commands as outcome-unknown, waits for the agent to return, observes host state, then retries with bounded backoff or marks retryable_failure.
host-agent-crash.idempotency: The agent keeps no durable state; each command is idempotent per (operation id, attempt) recorded by the operation manager.

libvirt-unavailable.retry_responsibility: Agent reports unavailable without side effects; operation manager applies bounded retry; observed state is marked stale, never guessed.
libvirt-unavailable.idempotency: Agent performs no partial libvirt mutation when the connection cannot be established.
